comparison.objective: Allow a spring reel to retract its cord, dock the work light, and release it; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Managing retracting-cord tension and docking a light versus precision mandrel alignment, tool-on-tool impact, and loose-metal-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Cord rewound and yellow light released in the grey dock; no docking tolerances provided. Candidate requires four fractures, no damage or loss, released tools, and two-second stability.
comparison.reason: Tests tension-aware docking rather than fracture-force regulation and debris recovery.
